description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class which implements LogNode interface. It acts as a filter in logging chains, passing only message content to the next node, removing metadata like tags and priorities.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that forwards only the message part of logs to the next log node in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter without a next node.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter(LogNode next)
methods.description: Constructor that sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println(int priority, String tag, String msg, Throwable tr)
methods.description: Processes a log message and forwards only the message content to the next node, if present.

methods.name: getNext()
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext(LogNode node)
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
